data.long_meaning: Andrade is a Portuguese name derived from the Old German words 'an' (one) and 'rat' (counselor or ruler). It originally meant 'man' or 'ruler' and later evolved to signify strength and courage. The name Andrade carries the meaning “Man, strong” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Andrade usually hope their child will grow to embody man, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.
